title: Write a Recipe: Steps, Variables and Content | Orchard Core
description:
A recipe is a JSON file that sets up an Orchard Core site, and writing one means knowing its header, its variables and the steps that do the work.

This video builds one recipe for a module, from the first property to the last step: the header, scripts and variables, the feature, themes and settings steps, a content type and a content item. Then it runs the recipe from Tools > Recipes.

In this video:
• What a recipe is and where it lives
• The recipe header
• Scripts and variables
• Features, themes and settings
• Content types and content
• Run the recipe
• More steps and reuse
